trailhead.label: The square in Kastelbell, the board’s start

cautions: Heat risk is high on this walk: start early and carry extra water.
The Sonnenberg is dry and south-facing: hot in summer, go early and bring water.
Lanes in Kastelbell and Staben at both ends: lead on.
Orchards and vineyards beside the path are farmed and closed to dogs in Kastelbell-Tschars: keep to the path.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
